standard: AUTONOMOUS EXECUTION LOOP STANDARD — Universal v2
goal: Restore portable, parser-confirmed portfolio verification when the globally installed LDW runtime does not include pytest.

iterations.requirement: Portfolio verification must use a pytest-capable repository runtime and establish execution results through the LDW test parser.

defect.root_cause: portfolio.py invoked sys.executable, which resolves to LDW's isolated installer runtime; that runtime has no pytest dependency. It also treated a zero process exit code as sufficient test evidence.

change.runtime_selection: Prefer an executable repository .venv/bin/python; otherwise use sys.executable.
change.test_evidence: Run pytest with -rA and accept execution evidence only when return_code is zero and parse_tests reports status=success and run_status=passed.
